item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena looks at a small printed word in her textbook by holding a convex lens close to the page. Later she holds a flat transparent glass pane over the same word.
How does the word appear through each material?

options.A: The word appears erect and enlarged through the convex lens, but the same size and shape through the flat glass pane.
options.B: The word appears erect and enlarged through both the convex lens and the flat glass pane.
options.C: The word appears smaller through the convex lens, but the same size and shape through the flat glass pane.
options.D: The word appears inverted through the flat glass pane, but erect and enlarged through the convex lens.
